Name: SWORD_ARTS_PARAM_ST
Description: Weapon Arts, not used in Sekiro

Fields.Name: Sword Arts Type
Fields.Description: Offset for TAE animation. 0 is a600. To pass to the behavior script to determine which swashbuckler

Fields.Name: Skill Speed Type
Fields.Description: Value handed to the behaviour script (HKS env 121) for the skill of the given hand. Per the developer notes it picks the skill's cancel timing: 0 normal (left-hand attack), 1 early, 2 slow.

Fields.Name: Arts Points - L1
Fields.Description: Points to spend when putting out arts by L1

Fields.Name: Arts Points - L2
Fields.Description: Points to spend when putting out arts by L2

Fields.Name: Arts Points - R1
Fields.Description: Points to spend when putting out arts by R1

Fields.Name: Arts Points - R2
Fields.Description: Points to spend when putting out arts by R2

Fields.Name: FP Cost: L1
Fields.Description: FP cost of the skill when used with L1. The cost is multiplied by the active SpEffects' Skill FP Consumption % and rounded up.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: L2
Fields.Description: FP cost of the skill's main use (L2). The cost is multiplied by the active SpEffects' Skill FP Consumption % and rounded up. The skill counts as short of FP when current FP is 0 or below half the cost.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: R1
Fields.Description: FP cost of a skill use or follow-up on R1 (for example bow skills, stance follow-ups).

Fields.Name: FP Cost: R2
Fields.Description: FP cost of a skill use or follow-up on R2.

Fields.Name: Shield Icon Type
Fields.Description: Older regulation layout only: replaced by Sword Arts Type.
